required_item: Measured Frontier source heat quantity, temperature grade, and temporal profile
value_summary: 49,869 valid 10-minute source intervals, 2,691 unavailable intervals, 75,573.6 MWh-th observed heat; mean 9.0927 MW and maximum 26.3353 MW.
source_locations: Workbook Frontier2023; Scientific Data article dataset description and data-record sections
derivation_or_extraction: Workbook numeric Overall_WasteHeat values summed with a 10-minute timestep; unavailable timestamps remain explicit.
claim_limit: Measured source availability only; not a receiving-demand trace.
downstream_decision: Use as measured source input for bounded dispatch scenarios.

required_item: ORNL hourly or sub-hourly receiving heat-demand profile or auditable reconstruction
value_summary: No public hourly or sub-hourly receiving-demand trace or auditable reconstruction input was found.
source_locations: Report Section 6 states collection of building heating/hot-water demand data posed notable difficulties.
derivation_or_extraction: Search covered the ORNL/OSTI report, ORNL publication page, Figshare, OSTI, and web-indexed HP ShowCase terms.
claim_limit: Do not claim observed or calibrated annual delivery.
downstream_decision: Retain only constant lower/upper demand-bound dispatch scenarios.

required_item: ORNL receiving heat-demand measured summary bounds
value_summary: Figure 13 reports one-year recorded space-heating summaries: Case A 5600-5700-5800 average 0.76 MW and maximum 2.09 MW; selected Case B average 1.31 MW and maximum 3.61 MW.
source_locations: Figure 13 Building Selection worksheet screenshot; Table 4 case definitions.
derivation_or_extraction: Manual transcription from the report figure; 0.76 MW * 8,760 h is consistent with >6,640 MWh/year.
claim_limit: Summary bounds only; no timestamped profile or load-shape reconstruction.
downstream_decision: Use for narrative demand evidence and bounds, not calibrated dispatch.

required_item: Frontier source-side heat-capture or heat-exchanger efficiency
value_summary: The article reports cooling distribution carries away up to 97%-99% of waste heat, but no new recovery heat-exchanger efficiency is reported.
source_locations: Scientific Data cooling-system description; ORNL report Frontier cooling-loop description.
derivation_or_extraction: The 97%-99% statement bounds heat carried in the existing cooling loop, not recoverable heat across a proposed exchanger.
claim_limit: Do not convert the bound into a measured case source-capture efficiency.
downstream_decision: Keep unity capture only as an explicit upper-bound sensitivity.

required_item: Balance-of-plant auxiliary electricity for heat recovery
value_summary: Frontier accessory/cooling power is measured, but incremental heat-recovery pumps, controls, and exchangers are not isolated.
source_locations: Workbook accessory-power columns; Scientific Data Figures 4-5 discussion.
derivation_or_extraction: Accessory power describes the existing facility cooling system, not the marginal auxiliary load of a new heat-recovery project.
claim_limit: Do not use measured accessory power as project auxiliary electricity.
downstream_decision: Keep project auxiliary electricity missing; generic values remain labeled as generic sensitivities.

required_item: Route length and plausible thermal-network path
value_summary: The report states existing steam travels about 1 mile with about 8% loss, and the official map locates relevant buildings; no designed Frontier hot-water route is published.
source_locations: ORNL report Case A discussion; ORNL Main Campus and Key map.
derivation_or_extraction: Existing steam-line distance and campus building context are not a new hot-water route geometry.
claim_limit: Do not claim calibrated thermal-network transport or a route-specific loss function.
downstream_decision: Treat near-distance transport as conditional/generic only.

value_summary: No pipe diameter, length-by-segment, insulation, pump head, flow, pressure-drop, trenching, or hydraulic profile was found for a new Frontier-to-ORNL hot-water network.
source_locations: Report and official map provide concept and building context only.
derivation_or_extraction: Absence confirmed after targeted route, pipeline, hydraulic, and HP ShowCase searches.
claim_limit: Cannot calibrate transport losses, pumping energy, or network CAPEX.

required_item: Storage tank volume and operating temperature difference
value_summary: No case-specific storage tank volume or operating Delta-T was found.
source_locations: ORNL report contains no storage design; Danish TTES datasheet is generic comparator evidence.
derivation_or_extraction: The reported 75-85 deg C heat-pump sink loop is not a storage-tank operating range.
claim_limit: Do not present generic tank sensitivity as a Frontier/ORNL storage design.
downstream_decision: Retain storage only as formula/generic sensitivity.

required_item: Outage/availability information for the measured source
value_summary: Scientific Data reports approximately 440 h lost to planned maintenance and unplanned downtime; the aligned calendar contains 2,691 missing 10-minute timestamps out of 52,560 expected intervals.
source_locations: Scientific Data Data Records section; generated source-potential inventory.
derivation_or_extraction: Calendar alignment rounds timestamp drift to nominal 10-minute timestamps and does not impute unavailable source heat.
claim_limit: Source downtime is measured; heat-recovery equipment availability is not.
downstream_decision: Use missing intervals as unavailable source intervals in dispatch.

required_item: Outage/availability information for the proposed heat-recovery system
value_summary: No case-specific heat-pump, storage, pump, exchanger, or network outage schedule was found.
source_locations: ORNL report case-study sections and Table 5.
derivation_or_extraction: Generic technology outage assumptions exist but are not Frontier/ORNL project evidence.
claim_limit: Do not claim observed annual heat-recovery-system availability.
downstream_decision: Use only explicit generic sensitivity assumptions.

required_item: Heat-pump technology capacity and COP used for bounded dispatch
value_summary: Carrier 61XWHZE case COP 3.08; three 1 MW-th units imply 3.0 MW-th total capacity.
source_locations: ORNL report Table 4/Figure 16 discussion and Carrier product envelope.
claim_limit: Unit performance evidence does not supply full balance-of-plant or installed project performance.
downstream_decision: Use for bounded technology and dispatch sensitivity.

value_summary: ORNL reports Carrier 61XWHZE-1000 capital cost of $200,000 per unit and payback times, but no full installed project cost or price year.
derivation_or_extraction: Equipment-only unit quote transcribed from the report; price year and balance-of-plant scope are not defined.
claim_limit: Do not compute Frontier-specific LCOH, NPC, or payback from this partial cost.
downstream_decision: Keep economics as generic comparator or partial equipment context.

required_item: Equipment, construction, refrigerant, and replacement lifecycle emissions
value_summary: No case-specific lifecycle inventory for heat pumps, storage, pipe network, refrigerant, construction, or replacements was found.
source_locations: ORNL report has operating CO2 reductions; EPA/EIA factors support operational emissions only.
derivation_or_extraction: Operational factors do not define cradle-to-grave equipment embodied emissions.
claim_limit: Do not claim case-specific lifecycle CO2e.
downstream_decision: Limit emissions to operational comparator sensitivities.

value_summary: No candidate receiving-water flow and upstream-temperature pair for a proposed residual heat discharge was found.
source_locations: TDEC inspection confirms sitewide permit context; Tennessee criteria define temperature limits.
derivation_or_extraction: Existing site monitoring and standards do not define a candidate outfall hydraulic heat capacity.
claim_limit: Do not calculate a site-specific receiving-water thermal capacity.
downstream_decision: Exclude new external receiving-water discharge as practical pathway.

value_summary: No approved new thermal outfall or mixing-zone definition for the proposed residual heat was found.
source_locations: TDEC inspection says TN0002941 covers existing discharges to White Oak Creek, Clinch River, and Melton Branch with more than 675 outfalls.
derivation_or_extraction: Existing permit context is not approval for a new thermal discharge by inference.
claim_limit: Do not treat existing NPDES coverage as residual-heat disposal permission.
downstream_decision: Exclude new receiving-water thermal discharge unless new permit evidence appears.

value_summary: Official campus map and Oak Ridge Reservation environmental reports establish site context and sensitive resources, but no project route or footprint clearance was found.
source_locations: ORNL Main Campus map; ASER wetland and protected-resource sections.
derivation_or_extraction: General site context cannot substitute for a route-specific environmental review.
claim_limit: Do not claim route clearance or absence of ecological conflict.
downstream_decision: Treat network/storage siting as conditional until route and footprint evidence exist.
